input_fields.name: failed_path_or_text
input_fields.description: One failing path/text value, source representation, error, and intended target identity.

input_fields.name: interpreter_constraints
input_fields.description: Target interpreter/version, filesystem rules, encoding expectations, and allowed path APIs.

result_fields.name: corrected_path_or_encoding
result_fields.description: One corrected path expression or encoding choice with target identity.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when path meaning or target identity is not proven.

procedure: Separate path parsing/escaping from file identity and preserve target basename/role.
Emit one canonical expression with explicit separators/joining and interpreter-supported text encoding.
Check normalization does not escape run root or change file role.
If target or encoding remains ambiguous, set needs_manual_review=true and emit no replacement.
rejection_rules: Reject missing identity, ambiguous base, unsafe traversal/reparse path, or unknown encoding.
Do not call path repair successful save/export.
